name: 치과 재료 연구실
prompt:
Cinematic progressive ink-line animation on a solid pure bright white background (#FFFFFF), edge to edge. The very first frame is an entirely empty white field. Static locked-off camera, one continuous 8-second take.

The subjects: an expert dentist comparing a translucent tooth model with a row of experimental ceramic samples inside a specialized laboratory, a young lab trainee observing through a large magnifying lens, an oversized articulated examination lamp cropped by the top edge, a progression of professional instruments arranged from beginner tools to advanced equipment, and a deep corridor of research benches suggesting the trainee's long career ahead.

0-3.5s: fine dark-charcoal ink strokes are traced visibly from endpoint to endpoint — each stroke confident, drawn once. The large landscape forms are drawn first with rich observational detail, the main subject last, in a few precise strokes. The composition is asymmetric — the main subject sits off-center. Built progressively, never fading in.

3.5-5.5s: fresh transparent watercolor fills the shapes FROM INSIDE, staying within the ink lines — clean turquoise on the laboratory cabinets, translucent ivory on the tooth model and ceramic samples, soft saffron on the examination lamp, and burgundy on the dentist's instrument case. Every color is bright yet softened as true watercolor — no primary crayon colors. One consistent light direction from the upper right, with soft believable shadows. The white background stays pure white.

5.5-8s: the dentist rotates the translucent tooth model toward the examination light and a concentrated golden glow passes through its thinnest edge; the trainee adjusts the magnifying lens until one ceramic sample snaps into sharp alignment beneath it. Everything else stays perfectly still.

Style: fine confident ink drawing with varied line weight and rich observational detail, fresh luminous watercolor, clear summer daylight, cinematic depth of foreground, middle ground and far horizon — the feel of a beautiful illustrated atlas for curious teenagers, never a kindergarten picture book. Museum-quality contemporary illustration.

Never: text, letters, primary crayon colors, muted grey or slate mood, sepia, ink-wash painting mood, fog, smiling sun, V-shaped birds, rainbows, dead-center composition, paint splatter, color outside the lines, camera movement, cuts, dissolve.
